Official Policy

Privacy Policy

Orchardly: Fruit Merge • Last updated: October 17, 2026

🍎 1. Overview

Welcome to Orchardly: Fruit Merge ("we", "our", or "us"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting it. This Privacy Policy explains our practices regarding user data for the mobile application available on Android and Google Play.

Summary: Orchardly: Fruit Merge is an offline-first casual puzzle game. We do not collect, store, sell, or transmit any personal identification information (PII) to external servers.

🔒 2. Data We Do NOT Collect

To provide a completely safe and private gaming experience, our application:

  • Does not collect your name, email address, phone number, or physical address.
  • Does not request access to your device contacts, camera, microphone, or media files.
  • Does not track your precise or approximate GPS location.
  • Does not collect financial, banking, or credit card information.
  • Does not track your activity across other applications or websites.

💾 3. Local Data Storage on Device

The application only stores gameplay progress locally on your device storage (such as unlocked level numbers, highest scores, coins earned through gameplay, unlocked skins, and sound/vibration preferences).

This data stays exclusively on your physical device. If you uninstall the app or clear its application data through Android device settings, this locally saved data will be erased.

👶 4. Children’s Privacy (COPPA & Google Play Families Policy)

Our game is designed to be family-friendly and suitable for players of all ages, including children under the age of 13. We strictly adhere to:

  • The Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA).
  • The Google Play Developer Program Policy for Families.

We do not knowingly collect any personally identifiable information from children under 13.

🛡️ 5. Permissions Used

Our app requires minimal Android device permissions strictly necessary for core gameplay functionality:

  • VIBRATE: Used solely to provide gentle haptic feedback on fruit drops and successful merges (can be disabled anytime in game settings).
  • WAKE_LOCK: Used solely to prevent your screen from dimming or locking while actively playing a round.

🔄 6. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any updates will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this page periodically.

📬 7. Contact Us

If you have any questions or feedback regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
